sources.title: Ablation (artificial intelligence) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: In artificial intelligence (AI), particularly machine learning, [1] ablation is the removal of a component of an AI system. An ablation study aims to determine the contribution of a component to an AI system by removing the component, and then analyzing the resultant performance of the system.
